description:
`ai` answers an OpenAI chat request with the AI you've chosen as your AI preference: a `/p/llm` tier or another LLM service anyone on your account can call.

The gateway rewrites `/ai/...` to your preference, the way it rewrites an `/a/<name>` alias, then routes it like any other call, streaming included. The preference names one service: a `/p/llm` tier, an LLM service from the marketplace, or one of your aliases. A service is one model, so the app never picks the model. Services that require enrollment are refused, including `e/<code>` enrollments and services (or aliases pointing at them) that can only be reached through an enrollment, because an enrollment brings its own parameters and model choices. With none set, `/ai` uses `labs/llm-balanced` (`/p/llm`, `model="balanced"`). A team key uses the team's own preference, or that default billed to the team, never a member's personal one. If the saved preference no longer resolves (a deleted alias, or a service that now requires enrollment), `/ai` answers 409 instead of silently using the default. `ai` itself is free: each call is billed by the service it resolves to, at that service's own price.

Point any OpenAI-compatible client at `/ai` with your UnitySVC key, and set your AI under **Your AI** in Preferences (or `PUT /v1/preferences/ai`). Switch provider or model there, without changing the app.
name: ai

payout_price.description: No platform commission — each call is billed by the AI service it resolves to

summary: Send an OpenAI chat request to `/ai` and UnitySVC answers it with the AI you've chosen — a `/p/llm` tier or another LLM service — with no service or model to hard-code.
